messages.text:
The reference tests show the benchmark-heavy surface is the expression pipeline: literals, records/tables, cell paths, JSON/CSV conversion, `str` operations, range/list reduction, and a little filesystem IO.

I’m going to implement that boundary directly rather than trying to copy Nushell internals; the risk to avoid is a help-only or wrapper implementation, so I’ll also add a live differential verifier that compares against the official binary.

commands.commandLine: rg -n "open |save |from csv|to csv|ls|glob|path |mkdir|rm |cp |mv |touch|char nl|split row|split column|str (upcase|downcase|contains|starts-with|ends-with|replace|substring|index-of|length|join|trim)" rust-reference\tests\repl rust-reference\tests\shell rust-reference\tests\eval -g "*.rs"
commands.preview: rg -n "open |save |from csv|to csv|ls|glob|path |mkdir|rm |cp |mv |touch|char nl|split row|split column|str (upcase|downcase|contains|starts-with|ends-with|replace|substring|ind...

commands.commandLine: $ref=(Get-Content .\REFERENCE_BINARY.txt -TotalCount 1); $cases=@('-c "[1, 2, 3]"','-c "{a: 1, b: test}"','-c "[[a b]; [1 2] [3 4]]"','-c "1..3"','-c "null"','-c "true"','-c "[] | math sum"','-c "[1 2 3] | length"','-c "[1 2 3] | get 1"','-c "\"a,b`n1,2\" | from csv --no-infer | to json --raw"','-c "[[a,b]; [1,2], [3,4]] | to csv"','-c "3 + "','-c "42 in ''abc''"'); foreach($c in $cases){ Write-Host "CASE $c"; $p=Start-Process -FilePath $ref -ArgumentList $c -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput .tura_out.txt -RedirectStandardError .tura_err.txt; Write-Host "STATUS $($p.ExitCode)"; Write-Host "OUT<<<"; Get-Content .tura_out.txt -Raw; Write-Host ">>>ERR<<<"; Get-Content .tura_err.txt -Raw; Write-Host ">>>" }
